bar_aware.description: Subtract space reserved by Noctalia bars when sizing the terminal, so it never runs under a bar.
bar_aware.label: Fit around bars

edge_h.description: Screen edge the terminal drops from in landscape.
edge_h.label: Landscape edge

edge_v.description: Screen edge the terminal slides from in portrait.
edge_v.label: Portrait edge

focus_policy.description: On demand keeps compositor keybinds working while the terminal is open. Exclusive grabs the keyboard. Applies on next launch.
focus_policy.label: Keyboard focus

hide_on_focus_loss.description: Hide the terminal when you click elsewhere. Applies on next launch.
hide_on_focus_loss.label: Hide on focus loss

kitty_conf.description: Kitten config file to use instead of ~/.config/kitty/quick-access-terminal.conf. Applies on next launch.
kitty_conf.label: Kitten config file

normal_height.description: Height of the normal-size landscape terminal, as a percent of the usable screen height.
normal_height.label: Normal height (%)

normal_width.description: Width of the normal-size portrait terminal, as a percent of the usable screen width.
normal_width.label: Normal width (%)

opacity.description: Background opacity. Applies on next launch.
opacity.label: Opacity

orientation.description: Landscape drops a full-width terminal from the top or bottom. Portrait slides a full-height one from the side.
orientation.label: Orientation

size.description: Full fills the usable screen along the drop direction.
size.label: Size

widget.finished: A command finished while hidden (exit {code}). Click to show.
widget.launch_failed: Could not run the dropkitty helper.
widget.title: dropkitty
